Apply-converged at HEAD 2504500. Independent inspection of the current source, generated Recorder artifacts, tests, docs, packed file list, and Review-002 chain found no authorized residual.

The Fixer contract has exactly the two blocker causes and the three apply settlements; plan/apply shapes are phase-separated; apply results are nonempty but not singleton-limited; names and completed commit IDs are independently unique; completed/refused/partial combination law is enforced; and no legacy top-level commit/classesRepaired or executable-unfinished-work shape is admitted. Coder retains its independent prior leaf, and no routing/orchestration mechanism was added.

The runtime validates singleton and phase/structure before each fresh audit, dispatches through the active model credential path, supplies Soul/packet/phase/transcript/candidate, preserves accepted candidates and audit usage unchanged, makes revise nonterminating, and sends malformed/auth/provider/transport audit failures through infrastructure abort/nonzero handling. Recorder now requires complete typed Fixer tool-result usage before acceptance/auditPassed projection and rejects both unaudited current and legacy leaves.

Review-002's three accepted classes are closed by 3193ed6, 5f78ece, and aa61d00: the Fixer subprocess uses a retained session directory with invocation.json and stderr.log; cited prose anchors were replaced by tool/schema/input and observable behavior checks while required byte-delivery checks remain; and Recorder provenance has positive and missing/malformed-usage reds. The rejected TypeBox-only whitespace repair was not introduced; trim rejection remains in the production validator.

Fresh current gates passed: typecheck; full suite 370 tests / 365 pass / 5 skipped / 0 fail; build:recorder; npm pack --dry-run (114 files, including source/generated Fixer contracts, auditor/runtime, and Recorder extraction); git diff --check. The worktree remained clean after generated/packed lifecycle checks.
